title: Tasks, microtasks, and event loop
learningObjectives: Explain tasks, microtasks, and event loop and implement reliable browser event and network workflows.

understand.concept: The event loop coordinates tasks and microtasks. Promise reactions and queueMicrotask callbacks run after the current stack completes, at a microtask checkpoint before the next task. Timers and many user events are tasks.
understand.whyItMatters: This model explains callback ordering and why long microtask chains can delay rendering. Synchronous code still blocks the main thread.
understand.analogy: Tasks are scheduled jobs; microtasks are follow-up work handled before the next task.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; JavaScript scheduling, HTTP semantics, and browser security follow platform standards.

explain.narrative: Synchronous output appears first, then queued microtasks in order, then the timer task.

examples.explanation: Synchronous output appears first, then queued microtasks in order, then the timer task.
examples.expectedOutput: Console or UI output demonstrates the concept; network examples require a configured endpoint.

practise.guidedTask: Add nested microtasks and timers. Predict the order and identify when rendering can occur.
practise.independentTask: Build an asynchronous feature with explicit states, cancellation, and error handling. Document which failures are safe to retry.
hints: Separate HTTP errors from network and parsing errors.
Use bounded retries only for suitable operations.
Tie UI updates to the latest active request.

questions.prompt: Which is processed before the next timer task?
questions.explanation: Microtasks are processed at the checkpoint before the next task.

questions.prompt: What is a reliable approach to network-driven UI?
options: Model loading, empty, success, failure, and cancellation states
Assume every fulfilled fetch means HTTP success
questions.answer: Model loading, empty, success, failure, and cancellation states
questions.explanation: Explicit states and bounded recovery make network interfaces predictable and safe.
